title: Toothbrush with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <rect x='44' y='42' width='12' height='50' rx='6' fill='#3ec7f0'/>
  <rect x='47' y='48' width='3' height='38' rx='1.5' fill='#a8eefc'/>
